controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.title: injury during a breakdown response on P-7111

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-7111 and PT-7111 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically monitoring seal-face condition and temperature. P-7111 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 1 June 2006 an incident occurred on P-7111 and PT-7111 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during a breakdown response, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
